<description> Standard PMD rules for Spring Boot microservices (PMD 7.x compatible) </description>
<!-- Critical Bug Detection --> <rule ref="category/java/errorprone.xml"> <!-- Marker/factory classes with only private constructors but no static methods --> <exclude name="MissingStaticMethodInNonInstantiatableClass"/> <!-- Common in test classes; @ParameterizedTest classes look like they have no tests --> <exclude name="TestClassWithoutTestCases"/> <!-- String constants in tests and small helper classes are acceptable --> <exclude name="AvoidDuplicateLiterals"/> </rule>
<!-- Best Practices --> <rule ref="category/java/bestpractices.xml"> <exclude name="UseVarargs"/> <!-- SLF4J handles lazy evaluation automatically; guard checks add clutter --> <exclude name="GuardLogStatement"/> <!-- Too restrictive for well-structured integration/service tests --> <exclude name="JUnitTestContainsTooManyAsserts"/> <!-- Conflicts with AssertJ assertion style (no separate message needed) --> <exclude name="JUnitTestsShouldIncludeAssert"/> <!-- Spring/JPA patterns legitimately use ArrayList/HashMap directly (PMD 7 location) --> <exclude name="LooseCoupling"/> <!-- Template method pattern intentionally uses non-abstract abstract classes --> <exclude name="AbstractClassWithoutAbstractMethod"/> </rule>
<!-- Code Style (minimal, avoid noise) --> <rule ref="category/java/codestyle.xml"> <exclude name="ShortVariable"/> <exclude name="AtLeastOneConstructor"/> <!-- Not idiomatic Java; adds visual clutter without safety benefit --> <exclude name="MethodArgumentCouldBeFinal"/> <exclude name="LocalVariableCouldBeFinal"/> <!-- Single-return style conflicts with guard clauses / early-return patterns --> <exclude name="OnlyOneReturn"/> <!-- Long constant names (SPRING_PROFILE_DEVELOPMENT) are intentional --> <exclude name="LongVariable"/> <!-- Trivial super() calls are unnecessary noise --> <exclude name="CallSuperInConstructor"/> <!-- Conflicts with idiomatic use of var --> <exclude name="UseExplicitTypes"/> <!-- Single-letter generic names like <T>, <ENTITY> are conventional --> <exclude name="GenericsNaming"/> <!-- Field ordering is enforced by IDE formatter; PMD rule is too strict --> <exclude name="FieldDeclarationsShouldBeAtStartOfClass"/> <!-- Short method names like ok() are common in fluent/builder APIs --> <exclude name="ShortMethodName"/> <!-- Filter setter methods return 'this' for fluent chaining; get/is prefix not applicable (PMD 7 location) --> <exclude name="LinguisticNaming"/>
<exclude name="UnnecessaryAnnotationValueElement"/>
</rule>
<rule ref="category/java/codestyle.xml/TooManyStaticImports"> <properties> <!-- Increase the limit to a more reasonable enterprise standard, e.g., 10 or 20 --> <property name="maximumStaticImports" value="20" /> </properties> </rule> <!-- Design Rules --> <rule ref="category/java/design.xml"> <!-- Spring fluent API chains (e.g. spec.and(...).or(...)) violate this --> <exclude name="LawOfDemeter"/> <!-- Test classes with @Nested or lifecycle methods trigger false positives --> <exclude name="TooManyMethods"/> <!-- BaseQueryService and ConditionBuilder are intentionally comprehensive framework classes --> <exclude name="CouplingBetweenObjects"/> <!-- Properties/constants classes are legitimate data holders --> <exclude name="DataClass"/> <!-- BaseQueryService is a designed comprehensive query helper --> <exclude name="GodClass"/> <!-- String building from multiple fields in toString() exceeds threshold but is correct --> <exclude name="NPathComplexity"/> <!-- Object parameters in alert APIs are intentional for extensibility --> <exclude name="UseObjectForClearerAPI"/> </rule>
<!-- Override CyclomaticComplexity threshold --> <rule ref="category/java/design.xml/CyclomaticComplexity"> <properties> <property name="classReportLevel" value="100"/> <property name="methodReportLevel" value="15"/> </properties> </rule>
<!-- Performance --> <rule ref="category/java/performance.xml"> <exclude name="AppendCharacterWithChar"/> </rule>
<!-- Security --> <rule ref="category/java/security.xml"/>
<!-- Multithreading --> <rule ref="category/java/multithreading.xml"> <!-- Non-concurrent utility/builder code does not need ConcurrentHashMap --> <exclude name="UseConcurrentHashMap"/> </rule>
<rule ref="category/java/design.xml/ExcessiveImports"> <properties> <property name="minimum" value="50" /> </properties> </rule>
</ruleset>

<!-- Awaitility — async assertions in tests --> <dependency> <groupId>org.awaitility</groupId> <artifactId>awaitility</artifactId> <version>${awaitility.version}</version> <scope>test</scope> </dependency>
</dependencies> </dependencyManagement>
<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ BUILD — PLUGIN MANAGEMENT ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── All plugin versions and default configurations are centralised here. Child projects activate a plugin by declaring it in their own <build><plugins> without repeating version or configuration. ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<build> <pluginManagement> <plugins>
<!-- ── Maven Compiler ─────────────────────── --> <!-- Configured with annotation processors for: • Lombok (code generation) • MapStruct (mapper generation) • Lombok-MapStruct binding (ordering) • Spring Boot configuration metadata • Hibernate JPA metamodel Child projects get all of this for free. --> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId> <version>${maven-compiler-plugin.version}</version> <configuration> <compilerArgs> <arg>-parameters</arg> </compilerArgs> <release>${java.version}</release> <source>${maven.compiler.source}</source> <target>${maven.compiler.target}</target> <encoding>${project.build.sourceEncoding}</encoding> <showDeprecation>true</showDeprecation> <showWarnings>true</showWarnings> <parameters>true</parameters> <!-- annotationProcessorPathsUseDepMgmt=true lets processor paths without an explicit <version> resolve from dependencyManagement (i.e. the Spring Boot BOM). Required for hibernate-processor whose version is managed by spring-boot-dependencies (Hibernate 7.x). --> <annotationProcessorPathsUseDepMgmt>true</annotationProcessorPathsUseDepMgmt> <annotationProcessorPaths> <!-- ORDER MATTERS: lombok before mapstruct, binding last --> <path> <!-- version resolved from spring-boot-dependencies BOM via annotationProcessorPathsUseDepMgmt --> <groupId>org.projectlombok</groupId> <artifactId>lombok</artifactId> </path> <path> <groupId>org.mapstruct</groupId> <artifactId>mapstruct-processor</artifactId> <version>${mapstruct.version}</version> </path> <path> <groupId>org.projectlombok</groupId> <artifactId>lombok-mapstruct-binding</artifactId> <version>${lombok-mapstruct-binding.version}</version> </path> <path> <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId> <artifactId>spring-boot-configuration-processor</artifactId> <version>${spring-boot.version}</version> </path> <!-- hibernate-processor: Hibernate 7.x renamed hibernate-jpamodelgen. Version resolved from Spring Boot 4.x BOM via annotationProcessorPathsUseDepMgmt. --> <path> <groupId>org.hibernate.orm</groupId> <artifactId>hibernate-processor</artifactId> <version>${hibernate-processor.version}</version> </path> </annotationProcessorPaths> </configuration> </plugin>
<!-- ── Spring Boot Maven Plugin ───────────── --> <plugin> <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId> <artifactId>spring-boot-maven-plugin</artifactId> <version>${spring-boot.version}</version> <configuration> <!-- Exclude Lombok from the fat JAR — compile-only --> <excludes> <exclude> <groupId>org.projectlombok</groupId> <artifactId>lombok</artifactId> </exclude> </excludes> <!-- Embed build info into /actuator/info --> <additionalProperties> <encoding.source>${project.build.sourceEncoding}</encoding.source> <java.version>${java.version}</java.version> </additionalProperties> </configuration> <executions> <execution> <goals> <goal>repackage</goal> <goal>build-info</goal> </goals> </execution> </executions> </plugin>
<!-- ── Git Commit ID (build info in Actuator) --> <plugin> <groupId>io.github.git-commit-id</groupId> <artifactId>git-commit-id-maven-plugin</artifactId> <version>${git-commit-id-maven-plugin.version}</version> <executions> <execution> <id>get-the-git-infos</id> <goals> <goal>revision</goal> </goals> <phase>initialize</phase> </execution> </executions> <configuration> <generateGitPropertiesFile>true</generateGitPropertiesFile> <generateGitPropertiesFilename> ${project.build.outputDirectory}/git.properties </generateGitPropertiesFilename> <includeOnlyProperties> <includeOnlyProperty>^git.branch$</includeOnlyProperty> <includeOnlyProperty>^git.commit.id.abbrev$</includeOnlyProperty> <includeOnlyProperty>^git.commit.time$</includeOnlyProperty> <includeOnlyProperty>^git.build.time$</includeOnlyProperty> </includeOnlyProperties> <commitIdGenerationMode>full</commitIdGenerationMode> <failOnNoGitDirectory>false</failOnNoGitDirectory> </configuration> </plugin>
<!-- ── Maven Enforcer ─────────────────────── --> <!-- Enforces: • Minimum Maven version • Minimum Java version • Dependency version convergence (no conflicts) Fails the build early if rules are violated. --> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-enforcer-plugin</artifactId> <version>${maven-enforcer-plugin.version}</version> <executions> <execution> <id>enforce-versions</id> <goals> <goal>enforce</goal> </goals> <configuration> <rules> <requireMavenVersion> <message> sakila requires Maven ${maven.version} or higher. </message> <version>[${maven.version},)</version> </requireMavenVersion> <requireJavaVersion> <message> sakila requires Java ${java.version}. </message> <version>[${java.version},)</version> </requireJavaVersion> <requireUpperBoundDeps /> </rules> </configuration> </execution> <execution> <id>enforce-dependency-convergence</id> <goals> <goal>enforce</goal> </goals> <configuration> <rules> <dependencyConvergence /> </rules> <fail>true</fail> </configuration> </execution> </executions> </plugin>
<!-- ── JaCoCo Code Coverage ───────────────── --> <plugin> <groupId>org.jacoco</groupId> <artifactId>jacoco-maven-plugin</artifactId> <version>${jacoco-maven-plugin.version}</version> <configuration> <excludes> <exclude>${jacoco.excludes.dto}</exclude> <exclude>${jacoco.excludes.entity}</exclude> <exclude>${jacoco.excludes.mapper}</exclude> <exclude>${jacoco.excludes.repository}</exclude> <exclude>${jacoco.excludes.config}</exclude> <exclude>${jacoco.excludes.app}</exclude> </excludes> </configuration> <executions> <execution> <id>jacoco-prepare-agent</id> <goals> <goal>prepare-agent</goal> </goals> </execution> <execution> <id>jacoco-report</id> <phase>verify</phase> <goals> <goal>report</goal> </goals> </execution> <!-- Coverage gate — activated in SIT profile --> </executions> </plugin>
<!-- ── Maven Surefire (unit tests) ────────── --> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId> <version>${maven-surefire-plugin.version}</version> <configuration> <!-- JUnit 5 platform --> <useModulePath>false</useModulePath> <runOrder>alphabetical</runOrder> <redirectTestOutputToFile>true</redirectTestOutputToFile> <!-- JaCoCo agent is injected via argLine --> <argLine>@{argLine} -Xmx1024m -XX:+EnableDynamicAgentLoading</argLine> </configuration> </plugin>
<!-- ── Maven Failsafe (integration tests) ─── --> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-failsafe-plugin</artifactId> <version>${maven-failsafe-plugin.version}</version> <configuration> <runOrder>alphabetical</runOrder> <!-- -XX:+EnableDynamicAgentLoading silences the Mockito self-attach warning on Java 21+ --> <argLine>@{argLine} -Xmx1024m -XX:+EnableDynamicAgentLoading</argLine> </configuration> <executions> <execution> <goals> <goal>integration-test</goal> <goal>verify</goal> </goals> </execution> </executions> </plugin>
<!-- ── Maven Resources ────────────────────── --> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-resources-plugin</artifactId> <version>${maven-resources-plugin.version}</version> <configuration> <encoding>${project.build.sourceEncoding}</encoding> <nonFilteredFileExtensions> <nonFilteredFileExtension>jar</nonFilteredFileExtension> <nonFilteredFileExtension>p12</nonFilteredFileExtension> <nonFilteredFileExtension>jks</nonFilteredFileExtension> </nonFilteredFileExtensions> </configuration> </plugin>
<!-- ── Maven Deploy ───────────────────────── --> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-deploy-plugin</artifactId> <version>${maven-deploy-plugin.version}</version> </plugin>
<!-- ── Maven Source ───────────────────────── --> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-source-plugin</artifactId> <version>${maven-source-plugin.version}</version> <executions> <execution> <id>attach-sources</id> <goals> <goal>jar-no-fork</goal> </goals> </execution> </executions> </plugin>
<!-- ── Maven Javadoc ──────────────────────── --> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-javadoc-plugin</artifactId> <version>${maven-javadoc-plugin.version}</version> <configuration> <source>${maven.compiler.source}</source> <encoding>${project.build.sourceEncoding}</encoding> <failOnError>false</failOnError> <doclint>none</doclint> </configuration> <executions> <execution> <id>attach-javadocs</id> <goals> <goal>jar</goal> </goals> </execution> </executions> </plugin>
<!-- ── Maven Checkstyle ───────────────────── --> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-checkstyle-plugin</artifactId> <version>${maven-checkstyle-plugin.version}</version> <configuration> <!-- Parent-enforced rules: every child module inherits the same policy. --> <configLocation>../sakila-parent/checkstyle/awsab-checkstyle.xml</configLocation> <suppressionsLocation>../sakila-parent/checkstyle/awsab-checkstyle-suppressions.xml</suppressionsLocation> <suppressionsFileExpression>checkstyle.suppressions.file</suppressionsFileExpression> <includeTestSourceDirectory>true</includeTestSourceDirectory> <inputEncoding>${project.build.sourceEncoding}</inputEncoding> <linkXRef>false</linkXRef> <consoleOutput>true</consoleOutput> <failsOnError>true</failsOnError> <failOnViolation>true</failOnViolation> <violationSeverity>error</violationSeverity> </configuration> <executions> <execution> <id>checkstyle-validate</id> <phase>validate</phase> <goals> <goal>check</goal> </goals> </execution> </executions> </plugin>
<!-- ── Maven Dependency (analysis) ───────── --> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-dependency-plugin</artifactId> <version>${maven-dependency-plugin.version}</version> <executions> <execution> <id>analyze-dependencies</id> <goals> <goal>analyze-only</goal> </goals> <configuration> <failOnWarning>false</failOnWarning> <ignoreNonCompile>true</ignoreNonCompile> </configuration> </execution> </executions> </plugin>
<!-- ── OWASP Dependency Check (CVE scan) ─── --> <plugin> <groupId>org.owasp</groupId> <artifactId>dependency-check-maven</artifactId> <version>${owasp-dependency-check.version}</version> <configuration> <outputDirectory >${project.build.directory}/dependency-check</outputDirectory> <formats> <format>HTML</format> <format>XML</format> <format>JSON</format> </formats> <!-- Fail build if any CVE >= 7.0 (HIGH or CRITICAL). Lower to 6.5 if you want to catch MEDIUM as well. --> <failBuildOnCVSS>7</failBuildOnCVSS> <suppressionFile> ${project.basedir}/src/main/resources/dependency-suppressions.xml </suppressionFile> </configuration> <executions> <execution> <id>dependency-check</id> <phase>verify</phase> <goals> <goal>check</goal> </goals> </execution> </executions> </plugin>
<!-- ── SonarQube ──────────────────────────── --> <plugin> <groupId>org.sonarsource.scanner.maven</groupId> <artifactId>sonar-maven-plugin</artifactId> <version>${sonar-maven-plugin.version}</version> </plugin>
<!-- ── PMD (static analysis) ─────────────── --> <!-- Runs two goals: • pmd – finds code style and design issues • cpd – detects copy-paste duplication Fails the build on any violation at verify phase. Override pmd.failOnViolation=false in a child to downgrade to a warning without changing this POM. --> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-pmd-plugin</artifactId> <version>${maven-pmd-plugin.version}</version> <configuration> <targetJdk>${java.version}</targetJdk> <minimumTokens>125</minimumTokens> <failOnViolation>${pmd.failOnViolation}</failOnViolation> <printFailingErrors>${pmd.printFailingErrors}</printFailingErrors> <includeTests>true</includeTests> <linkXRef>false</linkXRef> <rulesets> <ruleset>../sakila-parent/pmd/pmd-rules.xml</ruleset> </rulesets> <excludeRoots> <excludeRoot>${project.build.directory}/generated-sources</excludeRoot> <excludeRoot>${project.build.directory}/generated-test-sources</excludeRoot> </excludeRoots> </configuration> <executions> <execution> <id>pmd-check</id> <phase>verify</phase> <goals> <goal>check</goal> <goal>cpd-check</goal> </goals> </execution> </executions> </plugin>
<!-- ── SpotBugs (bytecode bug analysis) ──── --> <!-- Analyses compiled bytecode for common bug patterns. Effort=Max gives the most thorough scan. Threshold=Medium catches MEDIUM, HIGH and CRITICAL bugs. Override spotbugs.failOnError=false in a child to report without failing the build. --> <plugin> <groupId>com.github.spotbugs</groupId> <artifactId>spotbugs-maven-plugin</artifactId> <version>${spotbugs-maven-plugin.version}</version> <configuration> <excludeFilterFile>../sakila-parent/spotbugs/spotbugs-exclude.xml</excludeFilterFile> <effort>${spotbugs.effort}</effort> <threshold>${spotbugs.threshold}</threshold> <failOnError>${spotbugs.failOnError}</failOnError> <includeTests>true</includeTests> <xmlOutput>true</xmlOutput> <xmlOutputDirectory> ${project.build.directory}/spotbugs </xmlOutputDirectory> <plugins> <plugin> <groupId>com.h3xstream.findsecbugs</groupId> <artifactId>findsecbugs-plugin</artifactId> <version>${findsecbugs-plugin.version}</version> </plugin> </plugins> </configuration> <executions> <execution> <id>spotbugs-check</id> <phase>verify</phase> <goals> <goal>check</goal> </goals> </execution> </executions> </plugin>
<!-- ── Versions Plugin (dependency updates) ─ --> <plugin> <groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId> <artifactId>versions-maven-plugin</artifactId> <version>${versions-maven-plugin.version}</version> <configuration> <generateBackupPoms>false</generateBackupPoms> </configuration> </plugin>
<!-- ── Maven Site ─────────────────────────── --> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-site-plugin</artifactId> <version>${maven-site-plugin.version}</version> <configuration> <locales>en</locales> <outputDirectory >${project.build.directory}/site</outputDirectory> </configuration> </plugin>
<!-- ── Project Info Reports ──────────────── --> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-project-info-reports-plugin</artifactId> <version >${maven-project-info-reports-plugin.version}</version> </plugin>
</plugins> </pluginManagement>
<!-- ── Plugins active for EVERY child build ────── --> <!-- Only put plugins here that must run unconditionally in every module. Version-sensitive or optional plugins belong in pluginManagement only. --> <plugins> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-enforcer-plugin</artifactId> </plugin> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-checkstyle-plugin</artifactId> </plugin> <plugin> <groupId>org.jacoco</groupId> <artifactId>jacoco-maven-plugin</artifactId> </plugin> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId> </plugin> <plugin> <groupId>io.github.git-commit-id</groupId> <artifactId>git-commit-id-maven-plugin</artifactId> </plugin> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-pmd-plugin</artifactId> </plugin> <plugin> <groupId>com.github.spotbugs</groupId> <artifactId>spotbugs-maven-plugin</artifactId> </plugin> </plugins>
</build>
<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ BUILD PROFILES ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── Activate with: mvn clean verify -P SIT mvn clean verify -P UAT mvn clean package -P PROD ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<profiles> <!-- ── SIT (default) ────────────────────────────── • Unit tests run with full parallelism • Integration tests run via Failsafe • JaCoCo coverage gate: 80% line + 80% complexity • Checkstyle violations fail the build ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── --> <profile> <id>SIT</id> <activation> <activeByDefault>true</activeByDefault> </activation> <properties> <spring.profiles.active>sit</spring.profiles.active> <environment>SIT</environment> </properties> <build> <plugins> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId> <configuration> <skipTests>false</skipTests> <forkCount>1</forkCount> <reuseForks>false</reuseForks> <parallel>methods</parallel> <threadCount>10</threadCount> <useUnlimitedThreads>false</useUnlimitedThreads> </configuration> </plugin> <plugin> <groupId>org.jacoco</groupId> <artifactId>jacoco-maven-plugin</artifactId> <executions> <execution> <id>jacoco-prepare-agent</id> <goals> <goal>prepare-agent</goal> </goals> </execution> <execution> <id>jacoco-report</id> <phase>verify</phase> <goals> <goal>report</goal> </goals> </execution> <execution> <id>jacoco-check</id> <phase>verify</phase> <goals> <goal>check</goal> </goals> <configuration> <rules> <rule> <element>BUNDLE</element> <limits> <limit> <counter>LINE</counter> <value>COVEREDRATIO</value> <minimum>${jacoco.line.coverage.minimum}</minimum> </limit> <limit> <counter>COMPLEXITY</counter> <value>COVEREDRATIO</value> <minimum>${jacoco.complexity.coverage.minimum}</minimum> </limit> </limits> </rule> </rules> </configuration> </execution> </executions> </plugin> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-failsafe-plugin</artifactId> </plugin> </plugins> </build> </profile>
<!-- ── UAT ──────────────────────────────────────── • Full unit + integration tests • No coverage gate (gate runs in SIT) • Parallel test execution ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── --> <profile> <id>UAT</id> <activation> <property> <name>env</name> <value>UAT</value> </property> </activation> <properties> <spring.profiles.active>uat</spring.profiles.active> <environment>UAT</environment> </properties> <build> <plugins> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId> <configuration> <skipTests>false</skipTests> <forkCount>1</forkCount> <reuseForks>false</reuseForks> <parallel>methods</parallel> <threadCount>10</threadCount> <useUnlimitedThreads>false</useUnlimitedThreads> </configuration> </plugin> <plugin> <groupId>org.jacoco</groupId> <artifactId>jacoco-maven-plugin</artifactId> <executions> <execution> <id>jacoco-prepare-agent</id> <goals> <goal>prepare-agent</goal> </goals> </execution> <execution> <id>jacoco-report</id> <phase>verify</phase> <goals> <goal>report</goal> </goals> </execution> </executions> </plugin> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-failsafe-plugin</artifactId> </plugin> </plugins> </build> </profile>
<!-- ── PROD ─────────────────────────────────────── • Tests skipped entirely • OWASP CVE scan runs (fail on HIGH/CRITICAL) • Sources and Javadoc JARs attached for Nexus ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── --> <profile> <id>PROD</id> <activation> <property> <name>env</name> <value>PROD</value> </property> </activation> <properties> <spring.profiles.active>prod</spring.profiles.active> <environment>PROD</environment> </properties> <build> <plugins> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId> <configuration> <skipTests>true</skipTests> </configuration> </plugin> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-failsafe-plugin</artifactId> <configuration> <skipITs>true</skipITs> </configuration> </plugin> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-source-plugin</artifactId> </plugin> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-javadoc-plugin</artifactId> </plugin> <plugin> <groupId>org.owasp</groupId> <artifactId>dependency-check-maven</artifactId> </plugin> </plugins> </build> </profile>
</profiles>
<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ REPORTING ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<reporting> <plugins> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-project-info-reports-plugin</artifactId> </plugin> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-checkstyle-plugin</artifactId> </plugin> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-javadoc-plugin</artifactId> </plugin> <plugin> <groupId>org.jacoco</groupId> <artifactId>jacoco-maven-plugin</artifactId> <reportSets> <reportSet> <reports> <report>report</report> </reports> </reportSet> </reportSets> </plugin> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-pmd-plugin</artifactId> </plugin> <plugin> <groupId>com.github.spotbugs</groupId> <artifactId>spotbugs-maven-plugin</artifactId> </plugin> </plugins> </reporting>
</project>

<!-- ==================================================================================================================== AWSAB Base Parent POM ____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________ This is the Single Parent POM for all the Micro services. It deliberately DOES NOT extent the spring-boot-starter-parent. Instead, spring-boot-dependencies BOM is imported inside <dependencyManagement> so child projects inherit all Spring Boot managed versions while we remain free to override the Maven default lifecycle plugin versions ourselves.
CHILD PROJECT USAGE <parent> <groupId>com.me.learning.parent</groupId> <artifactId>sakila-parent</artifactId> <version>1.0.0</version> <relativePath/> </parent>
PROFILES SIT (default) – full tests + JaCoCo coverage gate (80 %) UAT – full tests, no coverage gate PROD – tests skipped ==================================================================================================================== -->
<groupId>com.me.learning.parent</groupId> <artifactId>sakila-parent</artifactId> <version>1.0.0</version> <name>sakila-parent</name> <packaging>pom</packaging> <description> Parent POM for all AWSAB microservices. Manages Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, OpenTelemetry, security, testing, and build tooling versions in one place. </description>
<licenses> <license> <name>Apache License, version 2.0</name> <url>https://me.com/sakila/sakila-bom/main/LICENSE.txt</url> <distribution>repo</distribution> </license> </licenses>
<organization> <name>AWSAB</name> <url>https://www.me.com</url> </organization>
<developers> <developer> <id>ramup</id> <name>Prabakaran Ramu</name> <email>prabakaran.ramu@me.com</email> <organization>AWSAB</organization> <organizationUrl>https://www.me.com</organizationUrl> </developer> </developers>
<scm> <connection>scm:git:https://gitURL-for-parent-bom</connection> <url>https://gitURL-for-parent-bom</url> </scm>
<distributionManagement> <repository> <id>releases</id> <name>Internal Releases</name> <url>https://XX.XX.XXX.XX:8081/repository/sakila-microservices/</url> </repository> <snapshotRepository> <id>snapshots</id> <name>Internal Snapshots</name> <url>https://XX.XX.XXX.XX:8081/repository/sakila-microservices-snapshots/</url> </snapshotRepository> </distributionManagement>
<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ GLOBAL VERSION PROPERTIES ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── ALL version numbers live here. Child projects must never redeclare a version — they pick it up from dependencyManagement / pluginManagement below. ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ --> <properties> <!-- ── Java / Maven build ─────────────────────────── --> <java.version>25</java.version> <maven.version>3.9.0</maven.version> <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding> <project.reporting.outputEncoding>UTF-8</project.reporting.outputEncoding> <maven.build.timestamp.format>yyyyMMddHHmmss</maven.build.timestamp.format> <maven.compiler.source>${java.version}</maven.compiler.source> <maven.compiler.target>${java.version}</maven.compiler.target> <maven.compiler.release>${java.version}</maven.compiler.release>
<!-- ── AWSAB Core Library ─────────────────────────────────────── --> <sakila-framework.version>1.0.0</sakila-framework.version>
<!-- ── Null Check ─────────────────────────────────────── --> <jspecify.version>1.0.0</jspecify.version>
<!-- ── Spring ─────────────────────────────────────── --> <!-- spring-boot: kept at 4.0.5 — next stable is 4.1.0 (currently RC). spring-cloud: 2025.0.x aligns with Spring Boot 4.0.x. Do NOT upgrade to 2025.1.x — it targets Spring Boot 4.1.x. --> <spring-boot.version>4.0.5</spring-boot.version> <spring-cloud.version>2025.0.0</spring-cloud.version>
<!-- ── API / Web ───────────────────────────────────── --> <!-- springdoc-openapi 3.x is required for Spring Boot 4.x. springdoc 2.x only supported Spring Boot 3.x. --> <springdoc-openapi.version>3.0.3</springdoc-openapi.version>
<!-- ── Logging ────────────────────────────────────── --> <!-- logstash-logback-encoder 9.0 requires Logback 1.5+ (provided by Spring Boot 4). --> <logstash-logback-encoder.version>9.0</logstash-logback-encoder.version>
<!-- ── Servlet Container ──────────────────────────── --> <!-- Tomcat 11.0.21 fixes 3 CVEs present in 11.0.20 (managed by Spring Boot 4.0.5 BOM): CVE-2026-34487 (HIGH) – K8s bearer token leaked into log file CVE-2026-34483 (HIGH) – JsonAccessLogValve output-escaping flaw CVE-2026-34500 (MEDIUM)– CLIENT_CERT auth bypass with FFM soft-fail off Remove this override once Spring Boot upgrades its managed Tomcat to 11.0.21+. --> <tomcat.version>11.0.21</tomcat.version>
<!-- ── Utilities ──────────────────────────────────── --> <commons-lang3.version>3.20.0</commons-lang3.version>
<!-- ── Persistence ────────────────────────────────── --> <!-- hibernate-processor: stay on 7.x stable (8.0.0.Alpha1 is not production-ready). Spring Boot 4.x BOM manages Hibernate at this same 7.x stream. --> <hibernate-processor.version>7.2.7.Final</hibernate-processor.version>
